5.x: Perennial character and work in the plains
**Perennial:** fed by **rain + snowmelt** (rainfall and melting ice); Himalayan rivers are **not dry in winter** – SW-monsoon rain alone does not explain this, the snowmelt does.
In the plains: gentle slope → **meanders, shifting channels, ox-bow lakes, floodplains**, braided channels and riverine islands; the Kosi changes its course.
Himalayan rivers show **all three stages** of the erosion cycle (youth, maturity, old age); **Peninsular rivers have reached maturity**.
The Northern Plain is formed by the interplay of the **Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra**.
